name: dansword
description: DansWord — non-profit educational project, free Word alternative for everyone, open source for anyone to edit

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/openxml/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.electron.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @dansword/core && npm run test -w @dansword/openxml && npm run test -w @dansword/desktop
scripts.test:electron: npm run build -w @dansword/desktop && playwright test -c playwright.electron.config.ts
